command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'HOST=%s USER=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$USER"
for x in claude codex opencode aider goose gemini ollama; do p=$(command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$p" ]; then printf 'EXEC %s=%s\n' "$x" "$p"; else printf 'EXEC %s=MISSING\n' "$x"; fi; done
for x in codex opencode aider goose gemini ollama; do if command -v "$x" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'VERSION %s=' "$x"; "$x" --version 2>&1 | head -1 || true; fi; done
printf 'CHATGPT_CLIENT='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'VOICE_SERVICE='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p Environment
echo SUMMARY_PASS
